Baked rice & bean casserole

Original EZEATS recipe · editorially reviewed draft · owner review required · not kitchen-tested.

Rice and black beans bake beneath a thin cheddar crust.

Tex-Mex-inspired · dinner, casserole · moderate

Servings: 4

Prep: 10 min

Cook: 30 min

Total: 40 min (estimate)

Estimated cost: USD 4 per serving. Not a price quote or a CAD conversion.

Diet and allergy suitability: unverified. Ingredient-list screening only, for the exact products specified. Brands, substitutions and cross-contact can change suitability. Editorial review is not kitchen testing or a medical or allergy-safety guarantee.

Known allergens: Milk. This list may be incomplete; check package labels and cross-contact.

Before you cook

  • Before starting, wash hands with soap and water for 20 seconds. Rinse fresh produce under running water and use clean utensils.
  • Check every packaged ingredient label for dietary requirements and allergens, including cross-contact notices. Choose products with no additional allergenic ingredients beyond the warnings listed here; otherwise these ingredient-based recommendations no longer apply. Listed tags apply only to the specified ingredients; they are not allergy-safe guarantees.
  • Refrigerate perishable ingredients until needed. Refrigerate leftovers in shallow containers within 2 hours (within 1 hour above 90°F/32°C); reheat leftovers to 74°C/165°F.

Ingredients

  • 3 cups ready-cooked rice (Use a fresh sealed plain rice pouch or rice promptly chilled and refrigerated. Check package labels; use the specified dietary version and check additional allergens and cross-contact notices.)
  • 3 cups canned black beans (Drained and rinsed; quantities are drained. Check package labels; use the specified dietary version and check additional allergens and cross-contact notices.)
  • 2 cups canned diced tomatoes (Include juices. Check package labels; use the specified dietary version and check additional allergens and cross-contact notices.)
  • 1 cup frozen corn kernels (Check package labels; use the specified dietary version and check additional allergens and cross-contact notices.)
  • 1 cup microbial-rennet cheddar cheese (Grated. Check package labels; use the specified dietary version and check additional allergens and cross-contact notices.)
  • 1 teaspoon mild gluten-free chili powder (Choose a dairy-free blend. Check package labels; use the specified dietary version and check additional allergens and cross-contact notices.)
  • 1 teaspoon olive oil

Cooking instructions

  1. Heat the oven to 400°F/200°C. Grease a 2-quart/2-liter baking dish with the olive oil.
  2. Mix the ready-cooked rice, canned black beans, canned diced tomatoes, frozen corn kernels and mild gluten-free chili powder in the dish and spread evenly.
  3. Cover tightly with foil and bake for 20 minutes. Uncover, scatter over the microbial-rennet cheddar cheese and bake for 10 minutes more.
  4. Check the center reaches 74°C/165°F; continue covered if needed. Rest for 3 minutes and divide into four portions.
